name: Missouri
dueDateNotes: Missouri follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Missouri starts from your federal AGI, subtracts the standard deduction and part of your federal income tax, then applies graduated rates topping out at 4.7% (2025). The Kansas City and St. Louis 1% earnings taxes are not included.
uniqueFacts: Missouri's top rate is 4.7% for 2025, and the first $1,313 of income is taxed at 0%.
Missouri lets you subtract part of your federal income tax (up to $5,000 single / $10,000 joint, phased down as income rises), which this calculator includes.
Starting in 2025, Missouri fully exempts capital gains from state income tax, the first state to do so.
If you work in Kansas City or St. Louis, a 1% local earnings tax applies to your self-employment income on top of the state tax.
